pdfkit.bundle.js - PDFKit 0.21.0 and the packages it is built from, as one
self-contained ES module (vendored 2026-11-23 from
https://esm.sh/pdfkit@0.21.0/es2020/pdfkit.bundle.mjs, renamed .js so every web
server serves it as JavaScript). See VENDOR.md.

Every package below is under the MIT licence (full text once, below). The
browser build of PDFKit does not include the Adobe standard-font metrics, so
Adobe's AFM notice does not apply to this file. (Up to 0.20.2 the bundle also
carried @swc/helpers, Apache-2.0, and unenv node shims; 0.21.0 needs neither.)

  fontkit 3.0.0              Copyright (c) 2014-present Devon Govett
  linebreak 2.0.0            Copyright (c) 2014-present Devon Govett
  png-js 3.0.0               Copyright (c) 2017 Devon Govett
  restructure 3.0.2          Copyright (c) 2015-present Devon Govett
  tiny-inflate               Copyright (c) 2015-present Devon Govett
  dfa 2, brotli 2, unicode-trie 3,
  unicode-properties 2       Copyright (c) Devon Govett (foliojs)
  fflate 0.8.3               Copyright (c) 2026 Arjun Barrett
  @noble/hashes 2, @noble/ciphers 2   Copyright (c) 2022 Paul Miller (https://paulmillr.com)
  base64-js                  Copyright (c) 2014 Jameson Little
